gpt_training_rotation_continuous/graphif.reason: The model-job mutex and monitor did not cover the graph indexing tool; default worker count was not checked before launch
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/graphif.evidence: graphify_update.log: AST extraction [24 workers]; installed graphify/extract.py _extract_parallel
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/graphif.remediation: Graph job has ended; all further graph updates use GRAPHIFY_MAX_WORKERS=1, which the installed implementation runs sequentially without a process pool

gpt_training_rotation_continuous/phase00.decision: Highest early mean+p25 on eight broader development seeds with all promotion guards passed; preserve aim and continue body adaptation for 500000 steps

gpt_training_rotation_continuous/phase00.purpose: Initialization of final aim-only block; deployment candidate will be chosen after the full research budget

gpt_training_rotation_continuous/process.incident: Two optional evaluation jobs overlapped while training owned six Python processes
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/process.remediation: Cancelled competing optional evaluations; replacing optional-job scheduling with a named mutex and process-count gate

gpt_training_rotation_continuous/protoco.goal: Keep raw 5139 observations and pure PPO; test continuous rotation for fast, stable scoring in unchanged full game
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/protoco.initialization: Reuse existing pure-PPO feature/body/critic/fire weights; initialize continuous rotation output to zero with learned Gaussian exploration
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/protoco.selection: First rank development checkpoints by 120-second mean plus p25, then full score and survival; screen finalists on eight broader development seeds before selecting exactly one candidate for heldout
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/protoco.promotion_guard: Heldout 120-second mean, 120-second p25, final mean score and mean survival must each meet or exceed the existing default on paired seeds
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/protoco.comparison_limit: This tests a pretrained model with a new action representation and curriculum; it is not a compute-matched causal comparison of action distributions from scratch
gpt_training_rotation_continuous/protoco.recording: TensorBoard, per-episode JSONL, per-checkpoint evaluation JSONL, source archives, hashes, experiment manifests and final report

plan_amendments.reason: Broader development survival regression after first full-game block; preserve aiming while adapting body at a lower learning rate

replay_mode_amendment.development_evidence: 003 400k sampled: 120s mean 1140, p25 1030, final mean 1455, survival 190.075 seconds on eight broader development seeds
replay_mode_amendment.heldout_note: Candidate weights and replay mode will be selected before running candidate on the untouched heldout cohort
replay_mode_amendment.remaining_training: Finish 003 for total research 1,000,000 steps; then two 500,000-step blocks, preserving aim first and adapting all actor weights at a lower rate last if development results support it
